name: deliberation
description: A second opinion from other models before you ship. Any host, any vendor, one verdict, and the disagreement stays visible.

interface.shortDescription: A second opinion from other models before you ship. Any host, any vendor, one verdict, and the disagreement stays visible.
interface.longDescription: GPT, Gemini, Grok, local, and OpenRouter models review the same plan or diff. In the consensus loop your agent commits a blind verdict before it sees the panel, every dismissed issue keeps a written reason, and the built-in analyzer measures what each model adds. Eight expert skills (Architect, Plan Reviewer, Scope Analyst, Code Reviewer, Security Analyst, Researcher, Debugger, Writing Editor) plus ask-all fan-out and arbiter-mediated consensus. Consensus can be wrong, so dissent stays visible and the final call stays with a human.
